title: Two-sided hom data for exterior sheaf restriction
statement: For a scheme X, an O_X-module M, a natural number n and an open U, there are morphisms e : (exteriorSheaf M n).restrict U.ι ⟶ exteriorSheaf (M.restrict U.ι) n and f in the opposite direction whose composites are identities.

proof.text: Reduce the sheaf restriction hom data to the presheaf pullback comparison, then apply sheafification compatibility with pullback and the restriction pullback isomorphism; package the resulting categorical isomorphism as two mutually inverse morphisms.

mathlib_searches.query: sheafification restriction open immersion exterior power

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_restrict_hom_data {X : Scheme.{v}} (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (U : X.Opens) : ∃ (e : (exteriorSheaf M n).restrict U.ι ⟶ exteriorSheaf (M.restrict U.ι) n),
      ∃ f : exteriorSheaf (M.restrict U.ι) n ⟶ (exteriorSheaf M n).restrict U.ι,
        e ≫ f = 𝟙 _ ∧ f ≫ e = 𝟙 _
